comment: Concatenation order of theme.css. One entry per /* SECTION name */. Add a component file (e.g. tabs.css) by inserting one entry. Order is cascade order: moving an entry can change the look; verify with tools/build-compare.mjs and tools/style-diff.mjs.

parts.name: tokens
parts.note: Base variables. Built from tokens.css after the palette conversion in build-runtime.mjs.

parts.name: native-icons
parts.note: Icon/background data-URI variables generated in build-runtime.mjs from original-assets SVGs.

parts.name: fonts
parts.note: Both OFL notices and all embedded @font-face rules. Default-font application stays in fonts-pixel-body.css (body-typography): moving it here would cross windose-runtime.css and change the cascade.

parts.name: sidebar-nav
parts.note: Owns sidebar navigation items. Follows motion-r8 (rather than navigation-r7) to preserve the former later position of the R8 active-item cursor while keeping all nav rules unlayered.

parts.name: badge
parts.note: Owns Badge/Kbd defaults, count modifier and pink-surface accents. Placed after legacy owners it replaces; defaults are layered so bell and other unlayered exceptions retain precedence.

parts.name: misc
parts.note: Owns shared separators, pagination, empty states and browse-history date rule; follows former owners to preserve cascade.

parts.name: splitter
parts.note: Owns shared draggable handles; follows data-surfaces where generic handle paint lived and retains the former later splitter-r97 cascade position.

parts.name: table
parts.note: Owns rendered table surfaces and row states after the former data-surfaces owner; placed here to preserve cascade position while migrating rules. Ordinary hover deliberately retains #302650.

parts.name: timeline
parts.note: Owns only timeline marker/connector/date paint; follows table for isolated component styling and preserves app-provided size/status classes.

parts.name: spinner
parts.note: Owns spinner-specific motion, sizing and loader sprite rules consolidated from legacy owners.

parts.name: card
parts.note: Owns Card defaults and modifiers; immediately after cards-r97, the last legacy card owner. The jirai-card layer intentionally yields to unlayered login/entity exceptions.

parts.name: tabs
parts.note: Owns every Tabs skin rule. Placed right after cards-r97, the last fragment that used to hold Tabs rules, so moved rules only move later. The @layer jirai-tabs block is the only named layer, so its priority is position-independent.

parts.name: toggle-group
parts.note: Owns ToggleGroup default skin; after the prior toolbar rule owners; isolated in jirai-toggle-group layer.

parts.name: button
parts.note: Owns the Button default skin and its three modifier levels. Last named layer before the choice layer.

parts.name: fields
parts.note: Unlayered field-suite owner after button.css: field-scoped rules must override the final jirai-button layer without !important.

parts.name: choice
parts.note: Owns checkbox, radio, native range, and Base UI slider appearance; last so component state rules are consolidated after their legacy owners. Switch remains in pixel-controls.css.
